Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back! The players have returned to the field. Sophia Dunkley and Danni Wyatt are the openers for England Women. It's going to be Renuka Singh to bowl the first over. Let's play...
... CHASE TIME ...

Jemimah Rodrigues and Harmanpreet Kaur helped India recover through their stand and then Deepti Sharma also played a vital hand. Jemimah's knock was critical in taking India Women over the 150-run mark. The English bowlers fared way better after picking the first two wickets and given their batting form, they will fancy their chances of overhauling the target. Can they do it or will India Women knock them out of the race for the final? Stay tuned to find out.

It was a sparkling start from India Women after electing to bat. Smriti Mandhana was in incredible form and took the charge in Powerplay. No English bowler was spared and India hammered 64 runs in the first six overs. Shafali Verma played second fiddle but was an important part of that 76-run opening partnership. England Women were under massive pressure but then fought back by removing both the Indian openers in the space of five balls.

A decent finish towards the end by India Women but they still will be disappointed as at one stage, the projected score was close to 200. Given the way this pitch has played, it can be termed as a challenging total but not a winning one. You can call it a teaser for both sides.

FOUR! Jemimah Rodrigues finishes with a boundary. She shuffles across the stumps way too early and seeing that Brunt delivers a full ball outside off. Jemimah still makes a good adjustment and whacks it over cover-point for a point. India Women end on 164/5.
Sneh Rana is the new batter but it will be Jemimah Rodrigues on strike.

OUT! RUN OUT! Brunt digs it in short again, on middle, Pooja Vastrakar pulls it in front of square on the leg side and attempts for the second run. She though is sent back. The throw comes to the bowler who breaks the stumps. They appeal and it's referred upstairs. The replays find that Pooja is just short of the crease.
Pooja Vastrakar is in next with two balls left.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Brunt delivers it short again, on middle and slower in pace once more, Deepti Sharma steps back and tries to pull it across the line but gets a massive top edge. The ball goes straight up in the air and Brunt calls for it. She moves to her right and collects the catch at covers.
Slower one, full and on middle, Sharma scoops it behind the keeper and returns for the second run. Katherine Brunt is not happy with the throw.
Snorter from Brunt! Short again, this time around off and shooting off the surface, Sharma somehow fends it away to the off side.
Mishit! Short and outside off, slower in pace, Sharma flashes her bat at it and slices it in the air. It clears cover-point and they get two. The 50-run stand comes up, off just 36 balls.
Katherine Brunt to bowl the final over.
Full toss on off, Deepti Sharma hits it towards long off for one.
Fuller again, Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to covers. A good stop by the fielder diving to her left. Single taken.
Fuller and on off, Deepti Sharma flicks it towards mid on for one.
Tossed up, on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps it towards short fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Jemimah is playing a gem here! Flighted and full, around middle and off, Jemimah Rodrigues steps back to give herself room and chips it over extra cover for a boundary.
Tossed up, around off, Deepti Sharma pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Sarah Glenn to bowl the penultimate over.
FOUR! What an over for India Women, 14 runs from it. Natalie Sciver lets out a full toss, around off, Jemimah Rodrigues stays leg-side of this delivery and clobbers it over covers for a boundary.
Outside off this time, Deepti Sharma lofts it towards long off. The ball goes in the air and lands just short of the fielder. They cross.
On a length and on off, slower too, Deepti Sharma looks to play a slog sweep but misses.
Shorter and on leg, Jemimah Rodrigues pulls it but finds the fielder at fine leg. Single taken.

FOUR! Streaky this time but they all count. Natalie Sciver tries to follow the batter down the leg side with a length ball, Jemimah Rodrigues attempts to heave it over the leg side but gets a top edge behind the keeper for a boundary.
FOUR! Cracking shot to begin this over. Fuller in length and around off, Jemimah Rodrigues steps back to make room and lofts it over extra cover for a boundary.
Natalie Sciver comes back into the attack.

PUT DOWN! This could cost England Women. Back of a length, around off, Deepti Sharma winds up for a big heave over the leg side but gets a top edge behind the bowler. Freya Kemp moves across to her right from mid on to take the catch but spills it over her head. The batters take two.
Fuller and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues mistimes her drive completely. The ball rolls towards mid on. They cross.
Shorter one on off, Jemimah Rodrigues eases it to covers.
Shorter one on off, Deepti Sharma gets in two minds but leaves it alone in the end. The keeper fumbles to collect it. They cross for a bye.
Serves a fuller one outside off, Deepti Sharma looks to play at it but misses.
Fuller and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues chops it down towards short third man for one.
Katherine Brunt is back into the attack to bowl at the death. 0 for 17 in her 2 overs so far.
Bowls it outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues guides it towards backward point for one. Good over for India Women. 12 runs off it.
Tossed up, around middle and leg, Deepti Sharma hits it towards long on for one more.
Fuller and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues hits it hard towards long off. Single taken.
Fuller one on off, Deepti Sharma uses her feet and hits it to long on for one.
FOUR! Deepti does it again. Loopy again, full and around middle, Sharma kneels and scoops it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
FOUR! Nicely played by Sharma. Flighted delivery, full and spinning down the leg side, Deepti Sharma plays the lap sweep and sends it to the fine leg fence. A good start to the over for India Women!
Sophie Ecclestone (2-0-15-0) is back into the attack.
Just two runs from the over. Tossed up, on leg, Deepti Sharma flicks it towards backward square leg for one.
Tossed up, around off, Deepti Sharma guides it to short cover.
Goes fuller again, Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps it towards deep square leg for one.
Fuller one this time, Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps it but finds the fielder at short fine leg.
Slight shorter and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues hits it to short covers.
Tossed up, outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues gets on her knees and looks to slog it but misses.
Fuller one outside off, Sharma defends it back towards the bowler.
Wide! Delivers it down the leg side, Deepti Sharma looks to give it a fine tickle but misses. Wide called.
Bowls it on a length, outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues cuts it towards deep backward point for one.
FOUR! Smashed! Jemimah Rodrigues will have to take control from here. Fuller in length and around off, Jemimah latches onto it and smashes it over mid off for a boundary.
On a length and on leg, Deepti Sharma flicks it towards backward square leg for one.
Deepti Sharma is the new batter.

OUT! KAUR HOLES OUT! A fantastic catch by Maia Bouchier and this is a big moment in this semi-final. Freya Kemp digs it in short, around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur goes on the back foot and pulls it across the line. She doesn't get much power behind the shot though. It flies to deep square leg where Maia Bouchier comes running in and dives forward to snap it inches above the surface. Sensational stuff.
Commentary.Howout: c Maia Bouchier b Freya Kemp

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! This one is launched over the fence. Slower one, on a length and close to off, Harmanpreet Kaur goes down on one knee and smokes it over wide long on for a biggie.
Natalie Sciver is shuffling her bowlers well here. Freya Kemp returns for her third over.
Tossed-up delivery, Harmanpreet Kaur dances down the track and hits it towards the fielder at long off. Takes a single.
Fuller one down the leg side, Harmanpreet Kaur plays a lap sweep towards fine leg for a brace.

FOUR! Harmanpret Kaur just loves playing square of the wicket on the leg side. Flighted and full, around off, Kaur goes down on one knee and sweeps it firmly in front of square leg for a boundary. India Women recovering well through this partnership.
Flighted up, around off, Harmanpreet Kaur guides it towards the fielder at point.
Tossed up on leg, Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Bowls a fuller one on off, Jemimah Rodrigues hits it but finds the fielder at mid off.
Change in bowling. Sarah Glenn (1-0-9-0) comes back into the attack.
Touch fuller and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur defends it away. 7 from the over!
Shorter one on leg, Jemimah Rodrigues swivels and pulls it but gets a top edge. The ball lands safely before the fine leg fielder and they cross.
Fuller one this time, Jemimah Rodrigues hits it but finds the fielder at mid on.
On a length around middle and leg, Harmanpreet Kaur gently pulls it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Wonderful shot! Fuller in length and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur reads the field well and heaves it over wide mid on for a boundary. A safe shot with the field up in that direction.
Serves a fuller one on leg, Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it towards backward square leg for a single.
Issy Wong is also back into the attack. She went for 12 runs in her opening over.
Goes fuller, around off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it to covers. Another quiet over is served by England Women.
This one lands fuller in length, Harmanpreet Kaur nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Around off, on a good length, Harmanpreet Kaur fails to defend from the back foot and is pinged on her right thigh pad.
Touch fuller, around off, Jemimah Rodrigues eases it to covers for one.

FOUR! Superb shot! India Women would want the boundaries to start flowing again. Very full in length and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues reaches out for it and steers it past the diving backward point fielder for a boundary.
Goes fuller and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it to covers for one.
Freya Kemp (1-0-3-1) is back on.
Goes fuller around off, Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it but finds the fielder at mid on.
Flighted up on leg, Harmanpreet Kaur forces it to long on for one.

Given lbw! Harmanpreet Kaur has decided to review the decision immediately. DECISION OVERTURNED! Coming to the delivery - Sophie Ecclestone serves a flighted delivery, close to off and it straightens a touch after landing. Harmanpreet Kaur is on the front foot to offer her defensive bat but she fails. It pings her on the front pad, they appeal and the finger goes up. DRS time. The UltraEdge finds a little spike and the on-field umpire overturns her decision.
Tossed-up delivery, Harmanpreet Kaur flicks it towards short mid-wicket. The fielder makes an excellent stop diving to her right. No runs.
Fuller again, around off, Harmanpreet Kaur defends it solidly.
Bowls a fuller one on leg, Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it towards square leg for one.
Sophie Ecclestone comes back into the attack.
Goes fuller again, this is blocked out. Good over for England Women. Just a run and one wicket from it.
Touch fuller this time, Harmanpreet Kaur defends it to mid on.
On a length and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur defends it solidly.
Harmanpreet Kaur is in next.

OUT! TAKEN! One wicket brings two and India Women have lost both their openers now in the space of five balls. The slower one works again for the home team. It's full and around middle, Smriti Mandhana shuffles across the stumps to unfurl the paddle scoop but fails to get the timing tight. It flies to short fine leg and Issy Wong takes a simple catch. England Women are fighting back.
Commentary.Howout: c Issy Wong b Natalie Sciver

Commentary.Commentary: Goes full and down the leg side, Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for one. Jemimah Rodrigues is off the mark.
Bowls it on a good length, Jemimah Rodrigues eases it towards the point fielder.
Natalie Sciver to bowl her second over.
Full toss outside off, Smriti Mandhana plays it but finds the fielder at mid off.
Jemimah Rodrigues is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! A wicket against the run of play for England Women. Freya Kemp comes up with a delivery on the shorter side around off, it lacks the desired pace to be put away across the line. Shafali Verma goes deep inside the crease to heave but only manages a top edge towards mid off. Katherine Brunt settles underneath it and provides England Women with the much-needed breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Katherine Brunt b Freya Kemp

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, around off, Smriti Mandhana dabs it to covers and takes a single.
Slightly shorter in length, Shafali Verma punches it to covers.
Outside off and much fuller, Shafali Verma looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge. The ball bounces towards the keeper.
On a length and down the leg side, Smriti Mandhana flicks it to mid on. The fielder has a shy towards nonstrikers end but misses. A direct hit would have been close.
Change in bowling. Freya Kemp to have a go now. She is the seventh bowler to be used by Natalie Sciver.
Tossed up, giving it some air, Shafali Verma dances down the track to play at it but the ball hits her pads and rolls towards short fine leg.
Flighted up, around off, Smriti Mandhana flicks it to mid-wicket for one more.
SIX! Put away in style! Floated and full, around off, Smriti Mandhana wears her skates to dance down the track and then heaves it over the cow corner fence for a biggie.
Bowls it on off, Smriti Mandhana defends it back towards the bowler.
Short of a length, Shafali Verma mistimes her shot over mid-wicket. They cross.
Tossed up on off, this is eased towards long off for one.
Change.
Sarah Glenn to bowl.
Flatter and on middle, worked to mid-wicket. End of the Powerplay, it's been a sparkling start from India Women - 64/0.

FOUR! Nearly a catch in the deep. Full toss around off, Shafali Verma pumps it down the ground but without much timing. It flies towards long off where Katherine Brunt decides to go for the catch and dives forward. It drops in front of her and then sneaks past to meet the fence.
FOUR! First from the bat of Shafali Verma. Flighted and full, around leg, Verma dances down the track and lofts it just wide of mid on for a boundary.
Gets forward and defends a full ball on the leg side.
Eases a full ball down to long on for a run.

FOUR! Welcome to the attack! Sophie Ecclestone serves a short ball around off, turning in, Smriti Mandhana rocks back and hammers it over square leg for a boundary. Fifty for Mandhana, off just 23 balls. Incredible.
Sophie Ecclestone comes into the attack.
Too full in length, very slow in the air, Shafali Verma fails to dig it out. 11 from this over!
Fuller on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, pulled to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Smriti Mandhana is toying with the bowler. 50 comes up for India Women and Shafali Verma has contributed only 5 runs in it. Mandhana has set the stage on fire. A length ball again, in the line of the stumps, Mandhana walks across the stumps and scoops it over short fine leg.
SIX! Smriti Mandhana is unstoppable. A length delivery around off, slower in pace again, Smriti Mandhana picks the variations and towers it over wide long on.
Slightly short and on off, slower in pace, Mandhana taps it down from the back foot to covers.
Natalie Sciver brings herself into the attack now.
Shortish and outside off, it's steered through backward point for a single. 12 from the over and India Women are cruising in the Powerplay.
FOUR! Mandhana is on fire! Fuller in length and around leg, Smriti takes a good stride forward and lifts it over mid on for a boundary.
Fuller and around off, defended from the back foot.
SIX! Massive blow! The first six of this match. Back of a length, around off, Smriti Mandhana picks the length quickly and heaves it massively over mid-wicket. Smriti Mandhana is motoring.
Fraction short and on off, Smriti goes on the back foot and cuts but finds the point fielder.
Starts with a length ball on the pads, Shafali Verma works it behind square leg and hands the strike to Smriti Mandhana.
Issy Wong comes into the attack.
In the channel outside off, Smriti Mandhana tries to cut from the back foot but misses. 11 from this over as well, India Women are off to a flying start.
Back of a length, on off, Smriti plays it down from the back foot to cover-point.

EDGY FOUR! Boundaries flying from the bat of Mandhana. A length ball, around off, Smriti tries to drive but it takes the outside edge and speeds past first slip for a boundary. This will frustrate Brunt.
On a length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana slices it past backward point for a brace.

FOUR! Superb timing! A touch short in length, around middle, Smriti turns inside the crease and pulls it with great timing through square leg. The ball keeps on racing and beats the fielder near the fence. A dive was needed but Issy Wong was late.
Amy Jones comes up to the stumps. One slip in place.
Lands it on a length around off, Shafali stays back and deflects it down to third man for a run.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Smriti Mandhana is very strong square of the wicket on the leg side. Full and around leg, Mandhana kneels and slog-sweeps it over square leg for a boundary. 11 from the over!
FOUR! Fine shot! Flighted around off, landing full and skidding in, Smriti Mandhana walks down the track and smacks it through the gap between mid off and extra cover.
Quicker and fuller, on off, Shafali knocks it down to long on for another run.
Tossed up, around off, Smriti Mandhana advances down the track and lofts it towards long on for a run.
Full and floated around off, Verma drives it straight back and the bowler makes a half stop. It rolls to mid on and they cross.
Starts with a short delivery, outside off, Shafali cuts from the back foot but finds the cover-point fielder.
Beaten all ends up! Brunt serves it on a fuller length, just outside off and shaping away, Mandhana tries to drive but misses. A positive start from India Women!
Delivers it on a good length and around middle, Smriti Mandhana defends it from the back foot.
FOUR! Elegance! Fullish delivery, outside off, Mandhana shows the full face of her bat and caresses it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary. Class.
Angling away, on a length outside off, Smriti Mandhana drives but finds the cover fielder.

Fuller again, around off, Shafali Verma works it towards mid-wicket where Sophia Dunkley makes a diving stop. They cross for a run. It could have been close in case of a direct hit at the bowler's end.
Very full in length, around off, Mandhana squeezes it out and finds the gap at backward point. India Women are away with a single.

Right then, the wait is over! The English players are on the ground. Fireworks go off as Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana enter the field. A good crowd has come to watch this game, as expected. Katherine Brunt is getting ready to bowl the first over. Smriti is on strike. Here we go...

Shafali Verma versus Katherine Brunt - both have been involved in some excellent battles in the past and everyone is looking forward to this duel between the two. Both are in great form as well. Who will come out on top? We will find out shortly.

Natalie Sciver, the skipper of England Women, says that she is happy to bowl first and adds that they are good at adapting to different conditions. Mentions that they are high on confidence in both batting and bowling, and are looking forward to this game.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the captain of India Women, says that it's a fresh track and will remain the same throughout the game. Adds that everyone is getting in form and it's the right time to perform for the team. Kaur is very happy with the way her bowlers have been performing so far.

England Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Danni Wyatt, Sophia Dunkley, Alice Capsey, Natalie Sciver (C), Amy Jones (WK), Maia Bouchier, Katherine Brunt, Sophie Ecclestone, Freya Kemp, Issy Wong, Sarah Glenn.

India Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Pooja Vastrakar, Taniya Bhatia (WK), Deepti Sharma, Radha Yadav, Sneh Rana, Meghna Singh, Renuka Singh.
Toss - Harmanpreet Kaur calls correctly and INDIA WOMEN ELECT TO BAT!

England hold the upper hand! Not just because of their recent form but historically also, they have proven to be better than India Women, especially in the knockouts. Unlike the 2020 T20 World Cup, it does not look like rain will be a spoilsport as the forecast is promising! If we keep the washout of 2020 aside, England came out on top in their two previous knockout meetings against India, defeating them in the 2017 World Cup final and in the 2018 T20 World Cup semi-final. Can India Women take revenge?
